name: @party/presenter
description: Overseer-extracted leaf package: the presenter-facing type contracts (PresenterCtx, CameraDirector, SeatLayout, GamePresenter). Exists so @party/client (which builds these) and every packages/games/* presenter (which implements against them) can both depend on the SAME types without a circular package/project-reference dependency — see this package's src/index.ts header comment for the full story.
